name: Avenues Rubik's Cube Open 2017
information:
**New Participants**
Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA
Step 2 - Register for the competition
Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AvenuesRubiksCubeOpen2017#2380-registrations-payments). 
**Returning participants**
Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions.
Step 2 - Register for the competition.
Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AvenuesRubiksCubeOpen2017#2380-registrations-payments).
Registration for the event will only be accepted **if a person has preregistered on the WCA page AND made the payment**.
For more details on the registration process please check the [registrations&payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AvenuesRubiksCubeOpen2017#2380-registrations-payments).
For the competition Schedule please check the [schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AvenuesRubiksCubeOpen2017#2381-schedule).
